title: Approximate ascent drag curve from Pezent 2024 Fig.2.13(b)
locator: Printed p.76 / PDF p.93, Fig.2.13(b); reference area from Table 2.18, p.77
method: Raster centerline digitization of the blue curve at 2 pixels per PDF point; calibration M=0 at x=244.5, M=7 at x=1047.5; Cd=0.2 at y=933, Cd=1.2 at y=727.5. Linear interpolation between adopted knots.
uncertainty: Approximate figure readout, not original numerical data or flight measurements. Pixel scale about 0.009 Mach and 0.005 Cd; steep transonic rise has larger coefficient uncertainty from Mach-axis readout. Endpoint values use nearest visible centerline.
geometry_scope: Published RasAeroII, 0-degree AoA, Falcon9-like full stack with 5.2 m fairing. Applying it to the mixed-source vehicle is an explicit model assumption.
